ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
rust_compiler:
- rust
target_platform:
- linux-64

about.description:
mcat parses, converts and previews files directly in your terminal.
It renders images, video, PDF, Markdown, Office documents and archives,
using inline terminal graphics protocols (kitty, iterm2, sixel) with an
ASCII fallback, and provides an interactive zoom and pan viewer.
about.summary: Terminal image, video, PDF, and Markdown viewer

build.script:
cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
cargo install --locked --no-track --path crates/core --root "${PREFIX}"
mkdir -p "${PREFIX}/share/bash-completion/completions" \
         "${PREFIX}/share/zsh/site-functions" \
         "${PREFIX}/share/fish/vendor_completions.d"
"${PREFIX}/bin/mcat" --generate bash > "${PREFIX}/share/bash-completion/completions/mcat"
"${PREFIX}/bin/mcat" --generate zsh  > "${PREFIX}/share/zsh/site-functions/_mcat"
"${PREFIX}/bin/mcat" --generate fish > "${PREFIX}/share/fish/vendor_completions.d/mcat.fish"

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.6.5"

package:
  name: mcat
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/Skardyy/mcat/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d998b70d88acc06910c0092e5724b72e617abe2d34e7a8601c47f56ff25bd0e1

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - if: unix
      then: |
        cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
        cargo install --locked --no-track --path crates/core --root "${PREFIX}"
        mkdir -p "${PREFIX}/share/bash-completion/completions" \
                 "${PREFIX}/share/zsh/site-functions" \
                 "${PREFIX}/share/fish/vendor_completions.d"
        "${PREFIX}/bin/mcat" --generate bash > "${PREFIX}/share/bash-completion/completions/mcat"
        "${PREFIX}/bin/mcat" --generate zsh  > "${PREFIX}/share/zsh/site-functions/_mcat"
        "${PREFIX}/bin/mcat" --generate fish > "${PREFIX}/share/fish/vendor_completions.d/mcat.fish"
      else: |
        cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
        if errorlevel 1 exit 1
        cargo install --locked --no-track --path crates/core --root "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%"
        if errorlevel 1 exit 1

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses

tests:
  - script:
      - mcat --version
      - mcat --help
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - mcat

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/Skardyy/mcat
  summary: Terminal image, video, PDF, and Markdown viewer
  description: |
    mcat parses, converts and previews files directly in your terminal.
    It renders images, video, PDF, Markdown, Office documents and archives,
    using inline terminal graphics protocols (kitty, iterm2, sixel) with an
    ASCII fallback, and provides an interactive zoom and pan viewer.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  repository: https://github.com/Skardyy/mcat

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Skardyy
